title: The Fourth Prince: Baby Boy #4 Edition

clues.text: By baby #4, Lily probably has approximately this many opinions about which brand of wipes is best.
Baby #1's pacifier falls on the floor: sterilize it. Baby #4's pacifier falls on the floor: do this.
For a first baby, the diaper bag contains 47 emergency items. By baby #4, the essentials are diapers, wipes, and this.
With four boys, Lily will hear this word yelled from another room approximately 6,000 times per day.
Experts call having four children 'a family.' Lily may eventually refer to it as this.
This mysterious substance will somehow be on the floor even five minutes after Lily cleans it.
The safest assumption when a house containing four boys suddenly becomes completely quiet.
With four boys in the house, this household expense may eventually require its own line in the family budget.
This innocent household object can become a sword, lightsaber, baseball bat, or weapon within approximately three seconds.
Lily's future grocery-store receipt may someday contain four gallons of milk, 36 eggs, 19 snacks, and somehow STILL not contain enough of this.
A newborn typically sleeps about this many hours per day: 8, 12, or 16.
Babies are born with more of these than adults: bones, teeth, or eyelashes.
This is the most common first word for babies, conveniently giving dads completely undeserved bragging rights.
Newborn babies can cry immediately, but they don't actually produce much of this until they're a few weeks old.
Babies are born without fully developed versions of these hard little things that adults have in their knees.
This animated baby wears a suit, carries a briefcase, and is significantly more concerned with corporate strategy than tummy time.
This famous royal baby became the son of Simba and Nala in The Lion King.
This green Star Wars character instantly became known to the internet as 'Baby Yoda.'
In The Flintstones, Fred and Wilma's tiny daughter has this rock-solid name.
Tommy, Chuckie, Phil, Lil, and Angelica belong to this cartoon franchise about babies with extremely active social lives.
Finish the saying: First is the worst, second is the best, third is the one with the hairy chest, and fourth gets...
Baby #1 gets a professionally designed nursery. Baby #4 gets a crib, clean sheets, and this important feature.
The traditional gift for a fourth anniversary is fruit or flowers. The traditional gift for a fourth baby should probably be this.
Four boys can officially play a complete game of this classic 2-vs-2 backyard sport without recruiting either parent.
Lily has already completed three newborn phases, three toddler phases, and countless diaper changes. Her official parenting difficulty level is now this.
